source: Blind per-bin reading of Heister, arXiv:1610.06536 v9, Figure 5 (HTML numbering; the body text calls it Fig. 6): opposite-sign di-muon data against the binned electron-muon data used as background, 1 GeV bins, linear y axis 0-70. Read by an AI reading agent with no access to MV2's repositories, report completed 2026-11-19T16:45Z. Values copied exactly as read, no edits. Reader's stated uncertainty: n +-0.5 (15-16 GeV bin +-1), v +-0.3 events. No error bars on the e-mu histogram. Reader's sums: n 362, v ~300.9, sum(n - v) over 29-32 GeV = 17.6.
